primaryTarget: gpux Scene compact replay with corrected old-to-new permutation
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Corrected Compact Scene Replay Operations Hypothesis

Using the completed original-to-sorted remap for in-place cycles will correct the only observed ordering defect while retaining the 86.21% metadata reduction and O(1) replay.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Implement the compact Scene representation from experiment 100 with exactly one algorithm correction: copy the old-to-new replay remap into sort scratch before applying safe cycle swaps. Include formatter-normalized source and focused tests. Renderer layouts, shaders, public APIs, dependencies, and adjacent cleanup are forbidden. Any compile, test, lint, or runtime failure ends the attempt and requires full revert.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Run formatter check, focused Scene tests, all gpux tests, gpui_wgpu tests, warning-denied clippy, and exclusive headed Test Suite WebGPU DataTable at DPR 1 and DPR 2. Verify compact size, stable duplicate-key identity, mixed replay, all established counters, exact final offsets, terminal errors, throughput, and paced p95 latency.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

All correctness gates pass; Scene stores 24-byte operations plus 8-byte remaps, moves primitive payloads once, and browser cadence has no material regression.
reportMarkdown:
# Corrected Compact Scene Replay Operations

The corrected implementation passed every static and correctness gate:

- gpux-scoped formatting
- 12 focused Scene tests, including stable duplicate-key identity and compact representation
- 421 gpux unit tests plus all integration suites
- 52 serialized gpui_wgpu tests
- warning-denied gpux Clippy
- headed Test Suite WebGPU DataTable at DPR 1 and DPR 2 with exact final offsets, established renderer/layout/text/style counters, and zero terminal errors

The mandatory browser performance gate failed:

| Metric | Accepted reference DPR 1 / DPR 2 | Candidate DPR 1 / DPR 2 | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| median acknowledged steps/s | 25.9955 / 26.2212 | 22.6251 / 22.4528 | -12.97% / -14.37% |
| paced p95 catch-up latency | 27.1414 / 27.1223 ms | 37.1313 / 37.1331 ms | +36.81% / +36.91% |

The representation achieved the intended 232-byte to 24-byte operation reduction plus an 8-byte remap and eliminated the duplicate insertion clone. However, building compact sort keys, sorting indices, copying the old-to-new map, and applying an in-place permutation every frame added enough CPU work to materially regress the virtualization workload. Memory reduction does not compensate for that measured hot-path cost.

The complete `scene.rs` production/test delta was restored from checkpoint `62609c9b71e1a802421b043a71bad800f9354c55`; an exact diff check confirmed no product delta remains.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Reject and revert compact replay locators with indirect sorting. Although correctness and memory goals were met, the representative browser workload regressed throughput by 12.97%/14.37% and paced p95 latency by 36.81%/36.91%. Keep the direct payload sort and full replay operations. Future Scene work must avoid adding an extra sort/permutation pass to frame finish.
